messages:
jamie_support: Customer AcmeXR reports repeated 503s from the hosted API starting ~09:12 UTC. They say it happens during long streaming responses + large embed requests. Logs attached by CS (see below).
cs_maya: Yep saw the alert, queueing customer call. They see ~30% request failure rate, p95 latency spikes too.
jamie_support: key excerpt from customer log: `error: upstream worker exited unexpectedly (signal 6)`, request id `acme-req-9f2` and `model: openredwood-large-v1`
oncall_dev_kai: @sre_oliver I'm on call — pulling runner logs. Any quick mitigations?
sre_oliver: Start by routing AcmeXR traffic to a lower-memory variant and enabling throttling. Also increase prefetch backoff.
eng_runtime_ana: Pulling GPU daemon logs. Initial look: repeated `cudaOutOfMemory` in prefetch path, then segfault during KV cache merge. Minimal stack: `infer_runner -> kv_prefetch -> attn_kernels -> segfault`.
oncall_dev_kai: Repro steps I'm running locally: 1) large embed batch (~4k tokens total) 2) streaming + toolcall 3) concurrent 8 clients. Repro hits `OOM` after ~45s.
jamie_support: Customer environment: hosted, standard GPU pool, 16GB cards, traffic burst at 09:10. They didn't pin quantized model.
eng_runtime_ana: Quick mitigation: set runtime flag `--kv-prefetch=false` for that customer pool and force model variant `openredwood-large-v1-quant` with lower memory. I'll stage a patch.
deploy_bot: rollback initiated for pool 'hosted-us-west-1-a' -> reverting last hot swap.
oncall_dev_kai: Patch staged to toggle prefetch per-customer. Applying to AcmeXR now. Will monitor.
jamie_support: CS on call with customer, communicated mitigation (routing + throttle). They accepted temporary slowdown.
sre_oliver: Observability note: p50 latency returns to normal after routing, p95 still elevated for streaming traces that hit older runner. No new core dumps after prefetch toggle.
eng_runtime_ana: Follow-ups: 1) add guards in kv_prefetch to bail if available_gpu_mem < threshold 2) add better OOM metrics (per-runner mem headroom) 3) backfill crash report + core dump analysis.
cs_maya: Will open customer ticket with timeline and actions, share postmortem when ready.
oncall_dev_kai: Action items assigned: Kai -> confirm rollback completion (done at 09:22), Ana -> PR for prefetch guard, Oliver -> add alert for prefetch OOM ratio.
jamie_support: Thanks team. Customer monitoring green for now, will re-open if 503s reappear. :thumbsup:
eng_runtime_ana: attaching quick log excerpt here:
```
[09:11:47] runner[pid=4211]: kv_prefetch: requesting 3.2GB
[09:11:48] runner[pid=4211]: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[09:11:48] infer_runner: caught OOM, attempting cleanup
[09:11:49] infer_runner: segfault at 0x7ffd... in attn_kernels.cu:421
[09:11:49] kernel: GPU reset triggered, container restart
```
jamie_support: I'll summarize and close thread after CS confirms stable for 1h.
